text: The 2024 Windows Arm patch changes win64-aarch64/debug to run-on-projects [comm-central]. The fixed accepted job retains that value. Its title says win-arm64 broadly, but the inspected diff changes only this debug job. Review scheduling at the job boundary before turning a commit title into a platform-wide rule.
